title: ALIGN: Word Association Learning for Cultural Alignment in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with specific cultures (US and China) using a two-tier framework: (1) lexical-level evaluation comparing generated word associations to human norms via overlap metrics (Precision@K) and psychological attributes (valence, arousal, concreteness), and (2) high-level cultural value evaluation comparing model response distributions on the World Values Survey (WVS) to population-level human response distributions using Jensen-Shannon distance (JSD) and Earth Mover's distance (EMD).
